lore.bio:
Rampart is a blue-collar, private business owner who just needs a big gun and a backpack full of scrap metal to get by in the dangerous, wild west world of the Outlands. Before opening her popular modding shop on Gaea, Ramya Parekh (Rampart for short) made a name for herself in the underground gauntlet circuit. Parekh climbed to the top showcasing pure skill using her custom-modded gear. She began taking jobs from smugglers, Syndicate members, and everyone in between. Some say it ain’t great unless it’s got “Rampart” written on it.
Parekh never shied away from letting people know how great she was, or better yet, how bad they were. Maybe that’s what led a group of assailants to ambush her at her shop one night. Her business burned down and she was left with nothing -- except an Apex Card. For Parekh, the Apex card is more than just an invitation to compete - it's a sign that she may have lost her shop, but she didn't lose what built it. Like her motto says, she's the kind of person who can always "turn crap into gold.”

For more information on Rampart's story, see Rampart (character).

passive.name: Battle Modder
passive.description: Increased magazine/heat capacity and faster reloads/recharge when using LMGs and the Minigun. Amped Cover permanently gains health with each Evo level, and its defensive capabilities have been reinforced.

tactical.name: Amped Cover
tactical.description: Build a dome-cover wall, which deploys a smaller but more durable cover that blocks incoming shots. Damage through or to Amped Shield charges the wall. Passing over the wall converts charges to a speed boost.

ultimate.name: Mobile Minigun "Sheila"
ultimate.description: Wield a mobile minigun with a single high capacity magazine. Place it down for anyone to use as a stationary and reloadable turret (Max: 1). Sheila now has an increased angle of 180 degrees, but ammo drains from the pip charge with each use.

details: [Passive] Buff -> Battle Modder: adds additional effect to old passive (Modded Loader). Cover walls permanently gain health as Rampart gains Evo Levels.

[Tactical] Buff -> Amped Cover: adds amped shield roof to wall, walls can now be charged by doing damage through the amped shield or by having the wall be damaged by enemies. Wall charge is converted to a speed boost by going over the wall - Wall can store up to 300 damage, which results in a 15 second speed boost at full charge. Speed boost time scales linearly with stored charge.

[Perks] Adjust -> Upgrades: Level 2 - Combat reserve: Bigger ammo stacks, extra grenades slots, access red weapon supply bins, Locked and Loaded: gain faster reloads and infinite ammo when behind amped cover and shield is in tact; Level 3 - Rebuild Module. Amped cover will regen health and rebuild shield section after not being damaged for a period of time.
